note: Generated by tee/internal/vectors from fixed inputs. Public keys are 1G, 2G, ... on P-256. Each message is SHA-256(abi.encode(string tag, field, ...)). HPKE and AES vectors are sealed in Go with repeatable randomness, to be opened in TypeScript. limits.reject inputs are Prefix then zero bytes up to Length, and every reader must refuse them before decoding. The approvedList sample pins the encoding only: its key-holder counts are wrong, so the TEE rejects it.
